Introduction
This 
document outlines the equipment inspection I1, which should be performed 
every six months as indicated by M6 in the title block.
This sensor used to measure the bearing vibration from turbine, generator and 
exciter bearings.
The first draft initiated by eng. Ashraf Farid, tested by 
eng. Adel Shawky, revised by EDEPC quality control eng. Abdl Menem Al Emam, accepted by eng: 
Aly Abd Elwhab, approved by eng. Fathy Mahmoud Ragab Head Sector of Talkha Power 
Station.
This document accepted by eng. Samir Abd El Gilil; 
 EDEPC inspection & quality control general director, MPIS coordinator, and certified by accountant Mahmoud Soliman: 
 EDEPC admin & financial inspection & quality control's general director, and 
 supervisor of inspection & quality control's head sector.
Safety Precautions
A work permit must be issued and the maintenance staff should carry 
 the suitable safety category.
Safety fence with caution marks surrounding the work area is 
 required.
Wear the safety and healthy equipment as safety shoes, 
 safety helmet, earplug, gloves pairs...etc
Unit should be out of service .
Tools and Equipment
Digital Multi-meter, type Fluke 85
Screw driver.
Work to be Carried Out
Measure the resistance between point 2 and point 1, 
 it must be 1.8 kΩ.
Measure the resistance between point 2 and point 3, 
 it must be 2 kΩ.
Measure the resistance between point ( 1, 2 or 3 ) and 
 point 6, it must be ∞ Ω, see figure 1
If the measuring value in step1 
 is not the value (1.8 kΩ, 
 2 kΩ,.∞ Ω) 
 then the transducer is defected and should be changed.
